summary: Stream AgentGuard audit events in real-time
description: Subscribe to the AgentGuard_Audit__e Platform Event and display events as they occur. Events show decision (ALLOW/BLOCK/THROTTLED/ROLLBACK), action name, policy, gate, reason, and latency. Use filters to focus on specific decisions, policies, or flagged events. Press Ctrl+C to stop streaming.
examples:
Stream all audit events:
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --target-org myorg

Show only BLOCK decisions:
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --target-org myorg --decision BLOCK

Show events from a specific policy:
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --target-org myorg --policy StrictPolicy

Show only flagged events:
<%= config.bin %> <%= command.id %> --target-org myorg --flagged
